--- WHAT THIS IS --- Mints a fresh iCloud link for each of 3 shortcuts and copies them to the clipboard.
It finds each one by name every time it runs, so a fresh import is simply found again. Nothing needs picking, and nothing goes stale between releases.
Each link asks you to confirm. If anything about the library is wrong it stops before the first one.

Stop if there is more than one Brightwheel Attendance. - Condition counts every copy, numbered or not - Linking either one would be a guess about which is the new build - Replace on the Mac hides the old copy from the app, not from this count
Delete every copy and import the new build once. If only one shows, delete it anyway: Replace hides the old copy until the new one is gone. Nothing was shared.

Stop if the only copy has a number after its name. - Condition counts copies named Brightwheel Attendance followed by a number - It would be shared under that name, and anything calling Brightwheel Attendance calls it by its exact name
Rename it to Brightwheel Attendance and run this again. Nothing was shared.
Brightwheel Attendance has a number after its name
Stop if Brightwheel Attendance is not in the library. - Condition is one minus the exact-name count - Above zero means there is none
Import it and run this again. Nothing was shared.
Brightwheel Attendance is not in your library

Walk the library and link each of the 3. - Input is My Shortcuts, the whole library - Each Repeat Item is one shortcut, found by its exact name
Link Brightwheel Attendance when this item is it. - Condition counts an exact match on this item's name - The item goes to Create iCloud Link as a variable, never a picked value
Link Brightwheel Check In when this item is it. - Condition counts an exact match on this item's name - The item goes to Create iCloud Link as a variable, never a picked value

Copy the rendered links. - One line per shortcut, in order - Then verify the links before publishing them anywhere
